descriptive_title: Grade 1 Mathematics: Demonstrations — Geometric Shapes, Position, and Movement (E1.1-E1.5)
short_description: A 5-day Grade 1 unit on spatial sense framed around Trekker Tig the Tiger Cub and Compass Coco the Cat. Children sort shapes, build 3D structures, identify matching halves, describe locations, and give directions on a treasure trail.
long_description: Set out on a treasure trail with Trekker Tig and Compass Coco! This 5-day Ontario-aligned Grade 1 unit covers all 5 Spatial Sense expectations (E1.1-E1.5) through a hands-on detective adventure. Day 1 sorts shapes by attribute. Day 2 builds 3D structures and finds 2D shapes inside. Day 3 introduces matching halves through folding. Day 4 describes treasure locations using positional language. Day 5 closes with a Treasure Trail Capstone where children give and follow directions. Includes 5 lesson plans with expanded walkthroughs (each tackling a specific Grade-1 trap: attribute drift, perspective trap, wrong fold, over-overuse of 'over', vague directions), 5 student worksheets, 12 paper manipulatives (2D + 3D shape set, paper blocks, symmetry shapes, treasure map mat, treasure tokens, capstone template, anchor charts, direction cards, poster, two character puppets), a mid-unit formative check, end-of-unit reflection sheet, class diagnostic checklist, three formative trackers, a 5-row summative rubric on Ontario's 4-level scale, a summative task script, and Junior Spatial Detective certificates. Pedagogical approach: hands-on construction, structured pair work, Canadian-flavoured treasure-trail narrative.
